label: Two stages
subgoals: Convert every noise figure and gain to linear
Divide the second stage's excess noise factor by the first stage's gain
Add the first stage's factor and convert back to dB

label: Longer chains
subgoals: Divide each stage's excess factor by the product of the preceding gains
Sum the terms for the full chain
Balance early gain for noise against later-stage linearity

label: Lossy stages in front
subgoals: Model a matched passive loss as F equal to L and gain one over L
Show that a front loss adds in dB to the next noise figure
Check that each stage's NF is for the source impedance it actually sees
